channel.title: Dads for Christ
channel.description: Encouragement for fathers, families, faith, leadership, and living boldly for Jesus Christ.

item.title: More Than a Paycheck
item.description: A paycheck can keep a household, and God calls a father to provide. Children still need his time, his attention, and a man who will lead them to Jesus.

item.title: Stay in the Room
item.description: Husbands and wives fight real battles. A father who stays in the room — listening, repenting, and praying — changes the temperature of the home.

item.title: What It Means to Reach One
item.description: Jesus left the ninety-nine to go after the one. That same mission still matters today. Who is the one person God may be calling you to pray for, encourage, and point back to Him?
